comparison.objective: Transfer exactly the selected tablets from a counting tray into a held vial without spilling or transferring extras.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual vessel alignment, controlled pouring and many-body flow management.
comparison.success_condition: Ten selected tablets in the vial, extras retained, no spill, vial elevated; stable for 1 s in the dispensing versions. No material rubric detail missing.
comparison.reason: Closest loose-body comparison, but the selected tablets begin spatially segregated and are poured into a narrow vial; it does not test aperture-based size separation of an intermingled load or screen reseating.
